tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Smooth limit of rescaled surgery caps is the standard initial metric] For $\delta '_n\to 0$, surgery caps attached to strong $\delta '_n$-necks of scales $h_n$, rescaled by $h_n^{-2}$ and based at their tips, subconverge smoothly to the standard initial surgery-cap metric.
Proof

\sketch Apply Claim 4; the cap-gluing construction identifies the limit with the standard initial metric.

□
